_what_this_is: Twelve image cases written in Chinese, for the multilingual half of src/README.md line 25.
_why_they_exist: line 25 requires the watch model to be multilingual AND multimodal. The multimodal half had 56 cases; the multilingual half rested on 8 Chinese pictures out of those 56 -- 2 + 2 + 4 -- which calibration/vision/measured.json itself says cannot carry a language split. This set gives the Chinese side enough to be read on its own.
source: hand-written in Chinese in this project's own session (seek-opensource-task), 2026-10-25
authorship: Written in Chinese from the start, as a Chinese ops room's traffic: 对账, 短信通道, 工单, 灰度发布, 演练, 快递柜, 会议室预订. NOT a translation of the English sets. Where a FAMILY is shared with an English case it is recorded per case in shares_family_with, with different content.
question: Do you need to do something about this message? Answer act or ignore.

labels.act: the picture shows something this bot must act on
labels.ignore: the picture shows nothing this bot must act on

design_note: Six act (three thin evidence, three clear) against six ignore (three evidence-like, three ordinary), so the set is not easier or harder by construction than the English boundary set. Captions are uninformative Chinese chatter. Every case is reported whatever it scored.
